svg.title: Raspberry Pi wiring
svg.desc: Raspberry Pi 5 GPIO header seen from above with the USB and Ethernet ports facing down. Tempo encoder on pins 9 GND, 11 S1, 13 S2, 15 KEY (optional), 17 5V to 3V3. Play/pause button on 21 D, 23 +, 25 −. Jog encoder on 31 5V, 35 S2, 37 S1, 39 GND. Display power on pins 2 and 6. Vocals button on 18 D, 16 +, 14 −. Drums on 24 D, 22 +, 20 −. Instrumental on 38 D, 36 +, 34 −.
svg.text: Raspberry Pi 5 from above, USB and Ethernet ports facing down
Never put an encoder or button wire on 5V (pins 2 and 4): GPIO pins only take 3.3 V
